As someone said, Rand and Moridin likely switched bodies in part because of the balefire streams. Nakomi may have helped, but Sanderson isn't allowed to say anything more about her. For all we know, she ''could'' be an avatar of the Creator.

As to the pipe itself. I don't think he's Ta'veren still. It's more like... he has power over the Pattern itself instead of the One Power. Ta'veren influence the world through various (relatively) random events. Rand's ability is that he can create these events at will.
